about: AI.7: the studio actions the chat's model may ask for, each declared once. tandem_backend.py builds the system prompt's action list, the validation (normalize_actions) and melody lock from it; actions.js runs each one in the studio. A Node test and a pytest check all three agree with this file. Param kinds: int and number are clamped to min..max; choice must be one of values ("$INSTRUMENTS" is voices.js INSTRUMENTS, "$DRUMS" kick, snare, hat, "$GROOVES" beats.js GROOVES ids, "$GENRE_CHOICES" none and genre.js GENRES ids) or the action is dropped; list keeps at most max items, each an object of item fields, an item whose choice field is not allowed is left out, and any other bad value drops the action. parts are the project parts an action changes; an object maps one param's value to its parts. Melody lock (ADR-004) drops every action that changes the melody part.

actions.name: set_tempo
actions.description: Set the song's tempo in beats a minute.

actions.name: set_instrument
actions.description: Play the melody on another instrument.

actions.name: transpose
actions.description: Move every melody note up or down by semitones, kept within MIDI 36..96.

actions.name: add_note
actions.summary: add_note (pitch MIDI 36..96, start and duration in seconds)
actions.description: Add one note to the melody.

actions.name: remove_track
actions.description: Clear the melody or the drums.

actions.name: generate_harmony
actions.summary: generate_harmony (style chords or bass: Tandem writes the chords part from the melody, in the song's key and genre)
actions.description: Write the chords part from the melody with the studio's own generator (harmony.js generateHarmony), as Generate does: chords or a bass line, in the key the studio's key menu chose (else the melody's key), in the genre's feel. The model never writes the harmony's notes.

actions.name: add_beat
actions.summary: add_beat (groove GROOVE_NAMES, bars 1..64: replaces the drums with a starter beat from the song's first bar)
actions.description: Replace the drums with a starter beat (beats.js grooveHits) for that many 4/4 bars, from the song's bar grid, as Starter beat does.

actions.name: set_genre
actions.summary: set_genre (none, GENRE_NAMES: also sets the melody and chords instruments)
actions.description: Choose the song's genre (genre.js genreChanges), as the Genre menu does: the genre and its melody and chords instruments; none clears the genre and keeps the instruments.
